levels.surface: أبو الحسن أحمد بن محمد بن الحسين البزاز
أبو القاسم بشر بن محمد بن بشير

notes: Ubaydullah tells his own encounter with Humayd, and Humayd speaks inside that account («فقال حميد: ما لك لا تأكل»), so Humayd is the last link (owner ruling 5). Harun al-Rashid and the servant speak or act in the story only and are not links.
The report number, the «وكان مسنا» remark and the author's closing remark are not part of the chain.
